verified_facts.text: Cloister is the original heart of The Boca Raton and has welcomed guests since 1926.
verified_facts.excerpt: The original heart of The Boca Raton, Cloister has been welcoming guests since 1926.

verified_facts.text: Cloister is defined by Mediterranean-inspired architecture, secluded courtyards and lush tropical gardens.
verified_facts.excerpt: Cloister has embodied the romance of South Florida, where Mediterranean-inspired architecture, secluded courtyards, and lush tropical gardens have created an unmistakable sense of place.

verified_facts.text: Cloister's rooms were newly redesigned in fall 2026.

verified_facts.text: The redesigned guestrooms honor the hotel's architectural character through a fresh, modern lens, with playful details.
verified_facts.excerpt: The guestrooms honor the hotel’s architectural character through a fresh, modern lens, with playful details that capture the vibrant spirit of The Boca Raton.

verified_facts.text: Cloister features rotating art collections and fashion collaborations throughout.
verified_facts.excerpt: Cloister is a place of discovery, with rotating art collections, fashion collaborations, and unexpected moments woven throughout.

verified_facts.text: Cloister's central location puts the resort's historic Golf Club, its Racquet Club and Spa Palmera within easy reach.
verified_facts.excerpt: Its central location puts some of the resort’s most celebrated experiences within easy reach, from our historic Golf Club and expansive Racquet Club to Forbes Five-Star Spa Palmera.

verified_facts.text: Spa Palmera is an ode to the Alhambra Palace, with arches, stonework, mosaic tiles and a courtyard with a lap pool.
